prompts.title: Blog Post Outline Generator
prompts.description: Creates a structured blog outline from a topic and audience.
prompts.content: Act as an expert content strategist. Create a detailed blog post outline about {{topic}} for {{audience}}. Include a hook, 5 main sections with sub-points, and a conclusion with a call to action.

prompts.title: Professional Email Rewriter
prompts.description: Rewrites a rough email draft into a clear, polite message.

prompts.title: Storytelling Hook Creator
prompts.description: Generates 10 attention-grabbing opening lines for any story or post.
prompts.content: Write 10 different opening hooks for a {{format}} about {{topic}}. Use a mix of styles: question, bold statement, statistic, and mini-story. Keep each under 25 words.

prompts.title: Code Explainer
prompts.description: Explains any code snippet line by line in simple language.
prompts.content:
Explain the following {{language}} code step by step as if I am a beginner. Describe what each part does, then summarize the overall purpose in two sentences.

```
{{code}}
```

prompts.title: Bug Finder and Fixer
prompts.description: Finds the bug in your code and suggests a fix with reasoning.

prompts.title: Unit Test Writer
prompts.description: Generates unit tests covering normal, edge, and error cases.
prompts.content:
Write unit tests for the following {{language}} function using {{test_framework}}. Cover normal cases, edge cases, and error handling. Add a short comment above each test describing its purpose.

```
{{code}}
```

prompts.title: Product Description Writer
prompts.description: Writes a persuasive product description focused on benefits.
prompts.content: Write a persuasive product description for {{product_name}}. Target customer: {{target_customer}}. Key features: {{features}}. Focus on benefits over features, keep it under 120 words, and end with a clear call to action.

prompts.title: 30-Day Social Media Calendar
prompts.description: Plans a month of social posts with themes and post ideas.
prompts.content: Create a 30-day social media content calendar for a {{business_type}} on {{platform}}. For each day give a theme, a post idea, and a suggested format (image, reel, carousel, or text). Target audience: {{audience}}.

prompts.title: Ad Copy A/B Variants
prompts.description: Produces multiple ad copy variants to test against each other.
prompts.content: Write 5 ad copy variants for {{product}} aimed at {{audience}} on {{platform}}. Each variant should use a different angle: pain point, social proof, urgency, curiosity, and benefit. Include a headline and body text.

prompts.title: Weekly Planner Builder
prompts.description: Turns your goals and commitments into a realistic weekly plan.
prompts.content: Build a realistic weekly plan for me. My top goals: {{goals}}. Fixed commitments: {{commitments}}. Available hours per day: {{hours}}. Include breaks and one buffer slot per day.

prompts.title: Meeting Notes Summarizer
prompts.description: Converts messy meeting notes into decisions and action items.

prompts.title: Decision Matrix Helper
prompts.description: Compares options using weighted criteria to support a decision.
prompts.content: Help me decide between these options: {{options}}. Ask me for criteria if needed, otherwise suggest 5 relevant criteria with weights, score each option from 1 to 10, and show a final weighted ranking with a short recommendation.

prompts.title: Explain Like I'm 5
prompts.description: Explains any complex topic using simple words and analogies.
prompts.content: Explain {{topic}} as if I am 5 years old. Use a simple analogy from everyday life, avoid jargon, and finish with one fun question to check my understanding.

prompts.title: Study Plan Generator
prompts.description: Creates a day-by-day study plan for any subject and deadline.
prompts.content: Create a {{days}}-day study plan to learn {{subject}}. My current level: {{level}}. I can study {{hours}} hours per day. For each day list topics, practice tasks, and a quick self-test.

prompts.title: Quiz Me Tutor
prompts.description: Quizzes you interactively and adapts to your answers.
prompts.content: Act as my tutor for {{subject}}. Ask me one question at a time, starting at {{level}} difficulty. After each answer, tell me if I was right, explain briefly, then ask the next question. Adjust difficulty based on my performance.
